integrity: The exact value is established by a support-functional classification and one-variable inequalities; the bundled checker verifies critical algebraic identities but is not used as a substitute for the continuum proof.
scientific_limitations: The calculation is specific to the real regular octagonal plane and does not determine the generalized mu_p profile for p different from 1.
The proof does not classify every extremizing Birkhoff--James pair.
Semantic and full-text checks cannot exclude an unindexed earlier observation of the same exact octagonal value.
title: Exact rectangular constant of the regular octagonal Banach plane
